description: This Java source file defines the MessagesRoute class, part of an Akka HTTP-based REST API for handling messaging endpoints related to 'things' and 'features' within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It builds various HTTP routes to send, claim, and handle messages for specific things and features, utilizing Akka streams, HTTP request/response handling, and Ditto messaging models.

classes.name: MessagesRoute
classes.description: A final class extending AbstractRoute that sets up Akka HTTP routes for handling message-related endpoints such as inbox, outbox, claim, and specific message processing for Things and Features in the Ditto framework.

methods.name: MessagesRoute
methods.description: Constructor initializing the MessagesRoute with necessary actor references, system, configs, and header translator, setting default and max timeouts.

methods.name: buildThingsInboxOutboxRoute
methods.description: Builds a route for handling inbox and outbox messages for a specific Thing.

methods.name: buildFeaturesInboxOutboxRoute
methods.description: Builds a route for handling inbox and outbox messages for a specific Feature.

methods.name: claimMessages
methods.description: Sets up the route for claiming messages from '/inbox/claim'.

methods.name: thingMessages
methods.description: Builds route to handle messages for a specific Thing under '/messages/<subject>'.

methods.name: getMessageDirection
methods.description: Determines the message direction (TO or FROM) based on the inbox/outbox path segment.

methods.name: featureMessages
methods.description: Builds route to handle messages for a specific feature under '/messages/<subject>'.

methods.name: buildSendThingMessage
methods.description: Creates a function to convert payload ByteBuffer into a SendThingMessage command with proper headers.

methods.name: buildSendFeatureMessage
methods.description: Creates a function to convert payload ByteBuffer into a SendFeatureMessage command with proper headers.

methods.name: normalizeSubject
methods.description: Normalizes message subject strings, removing initial slash if present, and validating subject.

methods.name: buildSendClaimMessage
methods.description: Creates a function to convert payload ByteBuffer into a SendClaimMessage command.

methods.name: enhanceHeaders
methods.description: Builds a DittoHeaders object with channel set to 'LIVE' and appropriate timeout string, for message headers.

methods.name: initMessageBuilder
methods.description: Initializes the MessageBuilder with payload, content type, and headers, decoding payload to string or JSON as applicable.

methods.name: handleMessage
methods.description: Handles the asynchronous process of sending a message command and completing HTTP response accordingly.

methods.name: checkMessageTimeout
methods.description: Validates that message timeout is within allowed range.

methods.name: checkClaimTimeout
methods.description: Validates that claim message timeout is within allowed range.
